scenarios.fault: client abandons its book requests mid-flight, then retries with the same key
scenarios.expected: one job, one set of tasks, one record; the retry returns the baseline result
scenarios.observed: first attempts: 202 then 206; 1 job id; retries [200, 200, 200]; recorded 1x

scenarios.fault: worker killed holding an exposure block
scenarios.expected: block reclaimed; EE/CVA within 1e-12 and PFE bit-identical to the local run

scenarios.fault: malformed message, a crash-looping task and an unpriceable task in the stream
scenarios.expected: malformed dropped and acked; crash-looper failed after MAX_DELIVERIES; the book still prices; nothing left pending
scenarios.observed: 3 worker deaths, poison: 'exceeded max deliveries', bogus: "unknown task kind 'bogus'", book diffs: 0

scenarios.fault: Redis unreachable for 0.4 s with the book half done
scenarios.expected: API answers 503 + Retry-After, breaker opens then closes, retry with the same key completes the same job once
scenarios.observed: 4 tasks left at outage; during: 503/503 Retry-After=5, breaker open then closed; 0 diffs, 6 messages

scenarios.fault: worker killed while holding a claimed task
scenarios.expected: another worker reclaims it; book prices identical to the clean run
scenarios.observed: held by ['doomed'] before recovery, 0 diffs after, reclaimed +1

scenarios.fault: original worker finishes after its task was reclaimed and redone
scenarios.expected: late write is identical; a late error never replaces the good result
scenarios.observed: duplicate rewrote task 0 identically, late error on task 1 left it untouched; 0 diffs
